title: Remaining 24 Model Holds After Resolution Integration
basis: Existing resolution evidence and accepted C4/E1/Sufix2/PLine7 integration; no new research, product changes, or publication attestation.
publicationBoundary: 114 is the locally included/possible fully checked publication total, not proof all 114 are live. The remaining 24 stay held; the 138-model main catalog is not complete. Main owns remaining checks and publication.

classificationNotes.manufacturer-evidence: Missing, inaccessible or conflicting manufacturer identity, physical specifications or original imagery. Software changes alone do not resolve these 22 holds.
classificationNotes.data-model: The narrow accepted primary facts for G5 UK and X8 Australia are already supported. Their distinct rating/region identities have not cleared all shared integration and calculation paths; do not treat them as missing-diameter cases.
classificationNotes.sourcePacketStatus: Records the evidence pack's own status, not the publication decision. Two source-verified packets are deliberately still held.
classificationNotes.catalogProgress: Use catalog-progress.json only as the exact 138-model ID inventory. Its earlier research-needed/published counters are stale and are not used as current publication state.
classificationNotes.priorIntegrationReview: The Group A compatibility review records an earlier code snapshot. This report preserves the accepted A2 hold decision; it does not claim those exact code defects were freshly rerun after integration14.

commonUnlockRules: Use exact manufacturer evidence tied to model/formulation, market, edition, rating basis, physical diameter and package units. An original manufacturer label may be evidence even when hosted elsewhere if its identity and provenance are verified; retailer-entered specifications alone are not.

A narrowly verified subset can unlock a model page without validating all old database strengths. Preserve unsupported rows as exclusions rather than relabeling, silently converting PE/mono equivalents or merging regions by lb.
Historical evidence can support a prominently dated edition, with a matching original manufacturer image and no unproven current formulation, package continuity or stock claim.

Closing a listed blocker only permits a new candidate review. Complete gold configuration, independent source/identity checks, integration tests, browser checks and main's publication approval remain required.
No disappearance from a search or current storefront proves discontinuation. Do not alter global rating semantics solely to launch the already accepted 114.

models.missingOrConflictingEvidence: One Australian Chartreuse SKU 49100 package verifies 6 lb, 0.06 mm and 150 m, but its separate regional identity has not cleared end-to-end integration. The earlier independent review demonstrated generic 6 lb ID remapping and indistinguishable regional choices. US diameter and yard/meter conflicts remain unresolved.
models.safeUnlock: Honor daiwa-j-braid-x8-braid-au-chartreuse-6, preserve SKU/barcode/region/package scope, leave the generic US row unchanged and excluded, and verify exact-ID defaults, selectors and handoffs. No new manufacturer diameter is needed for this one AU package; other rows stay held.

models.missingOrConflictingEvidence: No manufacturer SKU family establishes the generic Samurai Fluorocarbon inventory identity independently of J-Fluoro Samurai or Hidden Concept.
models.safeUnlock: Obtain an exact manufacturer label/catalog identity and its diameter/package mapping, or documentary alias evidence followed by a separately authorized identity decision. Do not duplicate J-Fluoro Samurai as a new model.

models.missingOrConflictingEvidence: No exact manufacturer mapping establishes Samurai Mono, its material/market and the legacy 6/8/10/12/14 lb diameter/package range. Regional Samurai Trout or Green discovery is not equivalence evidence.
models.safeUnlock: Obtain a dated manufacturer catalog or original package identifying the exact mono family, then coherent strength/physical-diameter/package rows and a matching image. Do not substitute the regional Trout/Green products or infer discontinuation.

models.missingOrConflictingEvidence: 214 current assigned variants establish product/package identity but not physical inch/mm diameter. Redirected legacy guides and inspected images do not supply it; one image's 50 lb alt text disagrees with its photographed 20 lb label.
models.safeUnlock: Find a manufacturer physical-diameter chart or readable exact-SKU label for Super8Slick V2, tied to a supported package and correctly matched photo. Original Super8Slick, standard PowerPro and mono-equivalent labels cannot supply its diameter.

models.missingOrConflictingEvidence: 70 assigned variants establish the original Maxcuatro packages but no physical inch/mm diameter. Inspected images and redirected legacy guides do not close the gap.
models.safeUnlock: Obtain an original Maxcuatro manufacturer diameter chart or readable exact-SKU label tied to the reviewed version and package. Do not calculate a diameter from the 25% claim or substitute Maxcuatro Metered.

models.missingOrConflictingEvidence: Four UK Steel Grey 150 m packages support Actual (AVG) 9.1/12.1/15.1/28.4 lb, not nominal 10/15/20/30/40 lb identities. Exact lb/kg labels and rating basis are not safely preserved across current shared selection, recommendations and nominal reel-reference calibration. Two other SKUs also have package/table kg conflicts.
models.safeUnlock: Separately approve and test rating-aware identity/display or isolate the four exact rows to compatible diameter-based paths. Preserve independently printed lb and kg, prevent average ratings from entering nominal-strength recommendation/calibration pools, and retain all legacy and conflicting-SKU exclusions. Do not change global rating semantics merely to launch the 114.

models.missingOrConflictingEvidence: Exact linked 400 m package images print 73/89/102/137 lb while European titles for the same LDA81SE5C SKUs use 76/99/113/151 lb. New Zealand kg agreement does not resolve regional/generation or rating-scale identity.
models.safeUnlock: Obtain manufacturer clarification or a clearly dated, internally consistent exact-SKU edition tying rating basis, physical diameter and package to one market. Do not select convenient values across generations or round them into legacy labels; any average-rated subset also needs compatible identity handling.

models.missingOrConflictingEvidence: US XBOTF 110 yd SKU identity is verified, but both physical-diameter columns are blank and the generic package image supplies no values. Japanese 100 m/GOU data has different strengths and no interchangeable US mapping.
models.safeUnlock: Obtain exact US XBOTF inch/mm evidence on a manufacturer chart or readable label. Using regional evidence additionally requires explicit identity equivalence and physical diameter; neither GOU conversion nor treating 100 m as exactly 110 yd is acceptable.

models.missingOrConflictingEvidence: Coherent 30/50 lb numeric rows and 150/600 yd packages are retained, but no traceable manufacturer product photo was recovered. The separate 40/60 lb inch/mm pairs conflict beyond displayed rounding.
models.safeUnlock: A traceable actual manufacturer image tied to Kantan can unlock a narrowly scoped 30/50 lb gold candidate after normal review. Keep 40/60 lb excluded until manufacturer correction or exact readable labels reconcile those pairs; do not invent a 65 lb variant.

models.missingOrConflictingEvidence: Exact Mach Braid fishing-line identity is unproved. MACH reel/combo capacity specifications are not line specifications, and historical APT-8 Speed Line is not an established alias.
models.safeUnlock: Obtain an original manufacturer line SKU or readable label establishing Mach Braid, then physical diameter, package mapping and matching product imagery. No APT-8 or reel-capacity substitution.

models.missingOrConflictingEvidence: No primary identity links Team Lew's Fluorocarbon to an actual line SKU. Pro SP reel manuals and historical APT Fluorocarbon Speed Line do not prove the mapping.
models.safeUnlock: Obtain original manufacturer SKU/label or documented alias evidence for this exact line, followed by coherent diameter/package rows and imagery. Do not use reel fluorocarbon capacities or substitute APT by name similarity.

models.missingOrConflictingEvidence: Team Lew's search results establish reels and mono attachment/capacity guidance, not this exact monofilament family. Historical Speed Line references do not prove an alias.
models.safeUnlock: Obtain an original manufacturer line SKU/label and a matching physical-diameter/package chart and image. Preserve the existing identity until that evidence exists; search absence is not proof of discontinuation.

models.missingOrConflictingEvidence: The current US feed supplies 22 exact variants but no physical diameter. Seven inspected manufacturer images leave numeric label areas blank; Korean KRSS8 charts give PE and maximum/average tensile loads, not inch/mm.
models.safeUnlock: Obtain an exact US physical-diameter chart or readable matching original label with strength and package identity. Do not convert PE to diameter or map Korean maximum breaking loads onto US lb-test labels.

models.missingOrConflictingEvidence: The 2014 US catalog verifies original Invisi-Braid but uses mono-equivalent TEST/DIA ratios. A promising 2024 SEA SUCFS*-IB lb/mm/length table is known only through search extracts: the original PDFs were not successfully retrieved, and one fetch met Bot Verification. Korean evidence supplies PE/max load, not physical diameter.
models.safeUnlock: Recover and inspect the original SEA manufacturer table and matching original product image, then preserve its exact SKU, region and edition in any candidate; alternatively obtain another readable exact original label. Snippets alone and the separately verified Inshore Camo model cannot unlock it.

models.missingOrConflictingEvidence: The US feed verifies 52 variants, but no physical-diameter table. Nineteen inspected original images provide no readable numeric diameter. Korea's DURA4-BRAID has no proven DuraBraid equivalence and uses PE/tensile figures.
models.safeUnlock: Obtain an exact DuraBraid manufacturer physical-diameter chart or readable original label tied to its package. Do not borrow Dura4, Stealth, retailer-entered or legacy database diameters.

models.missingOrConflictingEvidence: 20 current US variants cover 10/15/20/30/50 lb and 110/300 yd, but not physical diameter; inspected labels are blank. The 2014 TEST/DIA ratios are mono equivalents, while Korean New EZ uses PE/tensile ratings and 150/270 m packages. Legacy 40 lb remains unsupported.
models.safeUnlock: Obtain exact US manufacturer inch/mm evidence on a chart or readable matching label. Keep the unsupported 40 lb and unproven regional equivalents excluded; preserve actual package units.

models.missingOrConflictingEvidence: The original 2014 US catalog has distinct Ultracast 100% Fluorocarbon and EZ Fluoro families with different diameter charts. The generic inventory name has no SKU or alias selecting either; Fluoro-Braid is a different material.
models.safeUnlock: Obtain an original label/SKU or manufacturer alias identifying the intended family, then use only that family's dated diameter/package evidence and original image. Do not choose a chart by similar strength labels.

models.missingOrConflictingEvidence: The 2023 manufacturer catalog page 49 confirms LPB150/LPB300 strengths but has no physical-diameter column. Its 150 & 330 YD text conflicts with current LPB300 300-yard titles; legacy 40 lb is unsupported.
models.safeUnlock: Obtain exact manufacturer physical-diameter evidence and resolve the larger-package length, or use a readable exact 150-yard label for a narrowly scoped subset. Keep conflicting larger packages and unverified 40 lb excluded.

models.missingOrConflictingEvidence: Historical 2018 and current primary sources identify Top Secret as Ultra Premium Fluorocarbon Tippet with fractional/X-rated strengths, not the inventory's 6/8/10/12/15/17/20 lb mainline. The historical table also lacks physical diameters.
models.safeUnlock: Obtain manufacturer evidence for the exact whole-pound mainline identity, coherent diameter/package mapping and matching original image. Any separately authorized tippet model needs its own identity and workflow; do not retype or round tippet into these mainline IDs.

models.missingOrConflictingEvidence: Recovered 2015 Precision Tippet and Precision Indicator Mono are tippet/leader products; 2014 Competition Nymph Mono is a fly line. None verifies the legacy 6/8/10/12/15/20 lb Precision Mono mainline, its diameter/package matrix or matching image.
models.safeUnlock: Obtain an exact historical/current manufacturer mainline SKU or catalog/label showing name, role, strength, physical diameter and package with its original image. Do not substitute tippet, Indicator Mono, mono-core fly line, Fairplay or Nylon Leader Material.

models.missingOrConflictingEvidence: Original standalone/variant endpoints return 404. Current primary kit packaging explicitly says SuperPower Braid Line Texas Edition and presents a different 4X/200 yd diameter set; continuity with the unqualified original model is unproved.
models.safeUnlock: Obtain original SuperPower manufacturer chart/labels and matching package image, or explicit manufacturer continuity evidence followed by an authorized identity decision. Do not substitute Texas Edition, ColorShield or Silky8 under original IDs.

models.missingOrConflictingEvidence: The generic inventory material name has no manufacturer SKU provenance selecting older Kovert or current Classic/Xtreme/Essential/Elite. Current Classic artwork also contains conflicting inch/mm pairs.
models.safeUnlock: Establish the exact manufacturer formulation/SKU and edition, then obtain coherent physical-diameter/package evidence and its original image. Resolve any relevant unit conflict rather than picking a named Kovert formula or substituting coated FluoroKote.

models.missingOrConflictingEvidence: The original Destron Monofilament URL is unavailable; current manufacturer product/package says Destron Essential Monofilament. No primary rename/equivalence statement links that coated-nylon version to the unqualified inventory model.
models.safeUnlock: Obtain original Destron specifications/labels and image, or explicit manufacturer continuity evidence with exact SKU, formulation and package scope. Current Essential 300 yd variants cannot simply replace the old IDs.

models.missingOrConflictingEvidence: The generic inventory lacks a manufacturer model/SKU. Official Ultimate, Panfish and Ice are separate mono families; Ultimate is only a possible match. Its chart uses 14 lb rather than legacy 15 lb and differs at overlapping diameters.
models.safeUnlock: Identify the intended original family through manufacturer SKU/label or documented alias, then verify its own diameter/package rows and image. Do not rename the model to Ultimate or relabel 15 lb as 14 lb without an independently authorized identity decision.
